Endocrinology · published research

Pancreatic beta-cell regeneration

Summary of the Evidence

One study directly tested red-light exposure in cultured pancreatic beta cells and reported increased cell replication and cell-cycle progression. This is a cellular proliferation result, not evidence that PBM restores functional beta-cell mass in an organism (Huang et al. 2015).

Human and clinical evidence

No human study has directly tested PBM for pancreatic beta-cell regeneration.

Animal evidence

No animal study has directly tested PBM for pancreatic beta-cell regeneration.

In-vitro and ex-vivo evidence

Huang et al. reported increased replication and cell-cycle progression in cultured pancreatic beta cells after low-intensity laser irradiation. Pharmacologic and gene-silencing experiments implicated Akt1 and GSK3β signaling. The study did not demonstrate that the proliferating cells matured, secreted insulin appropriately, or improved glucose regulation in an organism (Huang et al. 2015).

Treatment Parameters and Generalizability

The experiment used 633-nm red light at an irradiance of 10 mW/cm² and tested fluences of 0.2, 0.4, 0.8, and 1.2 J/cm². These cell-culture exposures do not establish a dose or delivery route for treatment of the intact pancreas (Huang et al. 2015).

Interpretation

The study provides a laboratory signal for beta-cell replication and a candidate signaling pathway. It does not show formation of mature, functional beta cells or establish a clinical effect on insulin production or diabetes outcomes.

Publications and records

1 publication

Certainty of evidence (estimate)

Pancreatic beta-cell proliferation in culture: very low certainty. The finding comes from one laboratory study and has not been independently replicated.

Rationale for the certainty assessment

One in-vitro study reports increased cell proliferation, with no independent replication or animal or human evidence of pancreatic beta-cell regeneration. Pathway experiments support a cellular mechanism but do not establish mature insulin-producing function. The certainty estimate applies only to proliferation in the tested cell model (Huang et al. 2015).

Publication and study types
